question: For the earliest customer, what segment did he/she have?
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT T2.Segment AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Date ASC) AS __r FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T2.Segment FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID ORDER BY Date ASC LIMIT 1

b.request: What are the segments of all customers whose first transaction occurred at the earliest transaction date and time in the database?
b.sql: SELECT c.Segment FROM customers AS c WHERE c.CustomerID IN (SELECT t.CustomerID FROM transactions_1k AS t WHERE (t.Date, t.Time) = (SELECT Date, Time FROM transactions_1k ORDER BY Date, Time LIMIT 1));

c.request:
For the earliest customer, what segment did he/she have?
If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
c.sql: SELECT c.Segment FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID WHERE (t.Date, t.Time) = (SELECT Date, Time FROM transactions_1k ORDER BY Date, Time LIMIT 1)

d.request: What segment did the earliest customer have? If multiple customers tie for the earliest date, return all of their segments.
d.sql: SELECT c.Segment FROM customers AS c JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE y.Date = (SELECT MIN(Date) FROM yearmonth);
